newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudi Arabia barley purchase seen at $146-158,C+F.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia barley purchase seen at $146-158,C+F.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's purchase of about 1.4 million tonnes of barley was done at prices ranging from $146 to $158 per tonne, including cost and freight, European grain traders said on Monday.
The barley is for delivery from October to December.
A full written confirmation of the purchase was expected shortly.
Saudi Arabia had tendered to import 1.72 million tonnes of barley.
Traders linked the wide price range to freight costs depending on the port and the date of delivery sought.
Besides freight costs the prices also include in some cases costs linked to penalties for delays in delivering the grain.
"About $20 in freight and various costs (for instance the colouring of the grain) are included in the price," one trader said.
Freight costs range from betwen $14-$16 per tonne, depending on the port of delivery.
Traders said earlier congested Saudi ports may be unable to handle the purchase, predicting possible delays in deliveries.
